Read the claim as saying that established test-time scaling methods use explicit algorithmic repetition, search, and answer aggregation. It does not say every method uses all these operations.
Calling these operations 'symbolic' follows the post's broad use of that term for explicit computational procedures; it does not establish formal symbolic reasoning inside the neural model.

Treat this as an as-of observation about publicly documented methods available before July 13, 2025. These methods have no recurring reporting period, so the target has a publication cutoff and no invented lower bound.
